name: Tethered To You
source:
In this world, aspiring magicians must find a source for their power: a pact, or tether, with a patron - a devoted follower of any powerful deity. However, you're out of luck. All the patrons in town are taken. With your spirits low and hope dwindling as you wander to the next town, a call summons you deep into the woods - what do you have to lose?

A missing Goddess of Passion reveals four patrons to you - but can you keep your spirits up while you build a bond? Where is she, anyway? How long will it be before another deity takes interest in her struggling temple?

A dark fantasy visual novel about finding passion despite pressure to succeed.

[Edited from [url=https://finch-e.itch.io/tethered-to-you]itch.io[/url]]
